listen_ip.description: IP address of the network interface(s) to bind to (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all, or specific IP).

realm.description: STUN/TURN authentication realm (usually your Nextcloud domain).

cert_path.description: Path to TLS certificate in PEM format (required for TLS).

key_path.description: Path to TLS private key in PEM format (required for TLS).

use_turn.description: Enable TURN relay functionality for media traversal through NATs.

max_bandwidth.description: Maximum bandwidth (bytes/sec) per TURN allocation. Set to 0 for unlimited.

anonymous_auth.description: Allow anonymous TURN access (⚠️ disable in production for security).

allowed_peer_ips.description: List of allowed client IP ranges (CIDR notation) that may use the TURN server.

allowed_origins.description: List of allowed origins (e.g., https://your-nextcloud.site) for TURN REST API and CORS.

password.description: Password for the TURN user. Must be strong and securely generated.

turn_credentials.description: Static TURN credentials for Nextcloud to authenticate with the signaling server. Required unless using long-term credentials with HMAC.

no_ipv6.description: Disable IPv6 support (set to false if IPv6 is available and desired).

use_tcp_relay.description: Enable TCP relay for TURN (required in many restrictive NAT/firewall environments).

use_udp_relay.description: Enable UDP relay for TURN (more efficient but blocked by some firewalls).

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads. Recommended: number of CPU cores.

pidfile_path.description: Path to PID file for service management.

line.description: Any additional unparsed configuration line to append verbatim.

extra_lines.description: Raw configuration lines to append at the end of the file (for advanced tuning).
